questions.stem: What is a key difference between a supermarket and a department store?

options.text: Department stores offer a wider variety of products.

questions.explanation: Department stores typically offer a wider variety of goods organized into specific departments, while supermarkets focus on groceries and household items.

distractorRationale.a: Supermarkets are generally less focused on customer service compared to department stores.
distractorRationale.b: Supermarkets are often larger than small department stores.
distractorRationale.c: Department stores usually provide customer service rather than being entirely self-service.
